title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_trilhas_da_libertacao_by_divaldo_pereira_franco_tlvdk (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_trilhas_da_libertacao_by_divaldo_pereira_franco_tlvdk' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may lead to complete system takeover, requiring immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components due to potential persistent backdoors or additional malware installed.
